profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I'm a Senior Software Developer who's passionate about creating the absolute best technology to help people and companies succeed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working to build the best demos and code-free development experiences to enable everyone to utilize Azure Vision AI services more in their businesses.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Create demos for the Intelligent Kiosk.  The Kiosk app is a showcase of Microsoft AI used by the sales team and partners to help demonstrate and inspire people with the latest in Microsoft AI technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Founder
positions.description:
Invented and productized an affordable educational robotic arm that uses haptics instead of code for its programing.

Developed an intuitive touch screen interface that synchronizes an interactive virtual 3D model with its robotic hardware in real time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created a scaled down, tabletop version of an outdoor autonomous vehicle robotic delivery system.  The tabletop system integrated with their existing robotics platform for demonstrations at Tradeshows and easier software development without needing large robotic equipment.  The solution I devised used Anki Vector robots in place of 6-ton autonomous forklifts.

Developed an open source API for controlling the Anki Vector robot.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a cloud based multi-tenant manufacturing and fulfillment backend

Rearchitected their system to be hosted and scale in the cloud

positions.title: Demo Wizard of Machine Learning
positions.description:
Took the world by storm with my invention of Project Murphy. The innovative AI chat bot brought in millions of positive PR for Microsoft and pushed the needle within the company about what Microsoft’s Machine Learning can do. Attracts 6k new users daily.

Expanded on the success of Microsoft’s How-old robot by added a social human age guessing aspect and an Easter egg within the robot to visually recognize a Coke bottle in celebration of Coke’s 100 anniversary.  Increasing new users to 20k daily.

Invented a novel use of Sentiment Analysis which improves product reviews, expands customer insight and led to the creation of a new service offering.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a GPU based real-time virtual product rendering system.  Scaling to 200 images per instance, it has become the company’s backbone for ecommerce, marketing and customer engagement.

Through invention of fusing machine vision, laser cutters and embroidery machines together with highly tuned custom integration into their manufacturing plant, was able to provide a new corporate product offering of customized applique.

Key contributions in architecture to their main website and innovation in manufacturing automation led the startup’s steady growth from $700k to $24m annual revenue.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Scratch build the company’s core mission critical recruiting system replacing a previous multi-million dollar failed implementation using a small team and earning the companies “Director’s Award” for most significant achievement

Started a software consulting arm of the business, profitably growing it from 2 to 15 consultants

company.name: eXcell, a division of CompuCom Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Development and support of a complete barcode driven location tracking system which integrated into industrial truck scales, and organized waste management throughout the nation.

projects.title: Project Murphy
projects.description: For Microsoft Build Conference 2016 I built and released the auto face swapping chat bot Project Murphy to demonstrate novel use of machine learning. It also served as the first catalyst for the Microsoft Bot Framework. Attracts 6k users daily.
